title: Age of Empires IV
provenance: himbeles confirmed gameplay on the released r1 engine on 2026-11-15. Late Siege gameplay was tested with a local build of the r2 Wine changes on 2026-11-17 with Steam build 26559323, Highball 0.10.26 and D3DMetal on an Apple M2 Max with macOS 27.2.1.
notes: An opt-in recipe offers the AoE IV engine on Highball builds that include it. Apply the fix on the game's page, then launch with Play in Highball. If the game shows a graphics driver warning at startup, click OK to continue.
